name: Carrageenan
description: Vegetable gelling agent derived from edible red seaweed, commonly used as a plant-based gelatin substitute.
health_notes: Suitable for vegetarian and vegan diets.

name: Citric Acid
description: Organic fruit acid providing tartness and serving as a natural preservative.
health_notes: Non-toxic organic compound naturally present in citrus fruits.

name: Sugar
description: Simple carbohydrate providing quick energy and sweetness to food products.
health_notes: Excessive consumption is linked to dental caries, weight gain, and spike in blood glucose.

name: Palm Oil
description: Edible vegetable oil derived from the mesocarp of the fruit of oil palms.
health_notes: High in saturated fats. Excessive intake may increase LDL cholesterol.

name: Wheat Flour
description: Powder made from grinding wheat used as a primary structural ingredient in noodles, bakery, and snacks.
health_notes: Contains gluten. Unsuitable for individuals with Celiac Disease or wheat allergy.
